cohort: 151 preterm infants admitted to NICU/SNCU with less than 34 weeks of gestational age or less than 2000 grams birth weight and at least 3 weeks of postnatal life
finding: The incidence of ROP was 33.8%, and multiple gestation, PROM/PPROM, low birth weight, lower gestational age, prolonged oxygen exposure, blood transfusion, mechanical ventilation, sepsis, and phototherapy were significantly associated with ROP development.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to be significantly associated with ROP.
followup_time: 2 years (study duration), but specific postnatal follow-up time for each infant not mentioned
